findings.detail: Actual-report validation checks only the current report and does not require exact-candidate PASS results or certification evidence for requiredPredecessorLevels. Release support can be requested without proving platform, adversarial, and benchmark predecessors.
findings.requiredRepair: Add a closed predecessor-result binding contract; require exact candidate identity, PASS state, uniqueness, and all declared predecessor levels; add missing/wrong-candidate/duplicate predecessor regressions.
findings.title: Declared predecessor assurance levels are not enforced

findings.detail: The hierarchy declares requiredEvidence categories such as native_platform_receipt, cleanup_receipt, independent_review, support_matrix, and release_candidate_identity, but support-bearing validation only requires a nonempty generic evidence list.
findings.requiredRepair: Add typed evidence-category bindings, candidate/digest validation, uniqueness, and negative regressions for missing categories, duplicate reuse, and release support without independent review/support matrix.
findings.title: Level-specific required evidence categories are not enforced

findings.detail: The deterministic schema validator does not enforce minProperties, allowing an empty toolchain.components object to bypass canonical ToolchainIdentity.
findings.requiredRepair: Implement minProperties enforcement and add an empty-toolchain-components negative regression.
findings.title: Canonical minProperties constraints are not enforced

findings.detail: Time parsing accepts timezone-less or non-RFC3339 forms, and report.generatedAt is not required to be at or after the canonical execution interval.
findings.requiredRepair: Require strict timezone-qualified RFC3339 timestamps, aware comparisons, generatedAt ordering, and negative regressions.
findings.title: RFC3339 and report time ordering are incomplete

findings.detail: Evidence references are candidate-bound and syntactically hashed, but support-bearing validation does not resolve the URI or verify the digest against durable bytes.
findings.requiredRepair: Define deterministic repository/workflow-artifact resolution, verify existence and SHA-256, and add missing-target/digest-mismatch regressions.
findings.title: Support-bearing evidence URI and digest are unresolved

findings.detail: GitHub reports zero workflow runs, zero check runs, and no statuses for the exact candidate.
findings.requiredRepair: Run the final exact head on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS, inspect every job/step, and retrieve the manifest artifact.
findings.title: Exact-head CI and checks are absent

findings.detail: The committed manifest does not bind the current workflow path or current semantic/test changes.
findings.requiredRepair: Regenerate SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256 twice through the canonical owner and validate the exact resulting commit.
findings.title: Canonical source manifest is stale

findings.detail: The owner registry still contains only the active P8 set. The owner-preserving P2-004 tc.p2.acceptance-contract union has not been produced.
findings.requiredRepair: After the P8 source candidate is stable, publish and validate the owner-preserving registry union without replacing current P8 authority.
findings.title: MISSION-001 owner-union handoff remains unresolved

github.submissionConstraint: The connected GitHub identity is also the PR author and cannot formally submit REQUEST_CHANGES on its own pull request.
